kb_snapshot_note: §17.1748 — the v1.x pairs (Kahn, Keycloak, OAuth2, cache invalidation, …) named documents that are no longer in the corpus (lost before §17.855 pinned Milvus' etcd); the 2026-Q4 run scored 0/20 on them. v2.0 asks about what the corpus holds now; every expected_titles_contain matches at least one live title.

rebaseline.harness: HTTP /rag (W.8 ad-hoc; equivalent metric semantics to scripts/score_retrieval.py)
rebaseline.note: Sprint W.8 — quality held flat under 2x corpus growth (501 → 1093). MRR identical to KB=501 baseline; Recall@5 -1.7pt on a single multi-doc query (g016, 2-of-3 expected docs in top-5). One MISS (g011) consistent with prior runs. See OVERVIEW §17.26 + §18.

§17.230 — primary scoring metric switched from expected_entry_ids exact-match (brittle to topic-mode hash drift, see §17.211 + §17.229) to expected_titles_contain (case-insensitive AND-of-substrings against retrieved titles). expected_entry_ids retained per pair as archival exact-id metric. First post-§17.230 score landed against the §17.229 Tier A regrown corpus (565 → 685 entries). See OVERVIEW.md §17.230.
